name: Spirituality
overview: Scripture reveals spirituality as wholehearted love and devotion to God, exemplified by loving Him with all heart, soul, and might (Deuteronomy 6:5) and serving Him with full commitment (Joshua 22:5). This devotion is marked by delight in God's law and continual meditation on His truth (Psalms 1:2; 51:6), which leads to perfect peace for those who trust in Him (Isaiah 26:3). Such spirituality reflects a deep inward transformation that aligns the believer’s mind and affections with God’s covenant faithfulness (1 Kings 8:23).
